title: W-10 and W-20: backup file ACL is stripped after the file exists; chmod -N gets the path without --
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-10 (low), W-20 (low). The container is created at 0600 and its inherited ACL is removed afterwards by spawning /bin/chmod, so another user granted read by an inheritable directory ACL can open the empty file in that window and read the ciphertext later; this compounds a weak passphrase. Separately, an output path beginning with - is parsed as an option. Files: src/adapters/backup-file.ts, src/adapters/inherited-acl.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A target directory carrying inheritable ACL entries is refused, or the file is created with an explicit empty ACL
The path is passed after -- to chmod, with a test for a path beginning with -
